eval_instructions: These evals exercise the validate-observability skill against canned OTLP captures stored in `tests/fixtures/vo/`. The eval runner should pre-populate `.a365-observability-capture/traces.jsonl` with the relevant fixture content, write a `state.json` with a fake live PID (or leave it absent for one-shot mode tests), then invoke the skill with the listed prompt. Assertions inspect the markdown report printed to the console. The deferred endpoint-override spike (Task 0) means one-shot mode is not yet end-to-end runnable against a real agent — these evals exercise live mode by pre-seeding traces.jsonl directly.

evals.description: Clean trace produces zero findings — both the schema-driven and common-mistakes validators are silent.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the pre-seeded traces.jsonl, runs schema-driven and common-mistakes validators, and prints a markdown report stating zero errors, zero warnings, zero info findings.
expectations: Phase 0: state.json detected (live mode) OR absent (one-shot mode)
Phase 1A: traces.jsonl read and grouped by traceId
schema-driven.js validateSpan called for each span
common-mistakes.js validateTrace called for each trace
report.js format called on the merged findings
Final report shows 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 info
Cursor advanced after the run

evals.description: Missing required field surfaces a presence_check finding.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the missing gen_ai.conversation.id field and emits one rule-presence_check finding with severity error and a fixHint pointing at the field's role.
expectations: schema-driven.js validateSpan emits a rule-presence_check finding
Finding's metadata.field equals 'gen_ai.conversation.id'
Finding's severity is 'error'
Finding's fixHint mentions the field name and its required role
Markdown report groups the finding under its traceId

evals.description: Wrong-type field surfaces a type_conformance finding.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects gen_ai.agent.id is an integer (schema declares String) and emits one rule-type_conformance finding with severity error.
expectations: schema-driven.js validateSpan emits a rule-type_conformance finding
Finding's metadata.field equals 'gen_ai.agent.id'
Finding's metadata.expected equals 'String'
Finding's severity is 'error'
Markdown report shows the type mismatch

evals.description: S2S agent without CallerDetails surfaces rule-s2s_caller_details_required.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the invoke_agent span has no microsoft.a365.caller.* (or gen_ai.caller.*) attributes and emits rule-s2s_caller_details_required with severity error.
expectations: common-mistakes.js validateTrace emits rule-s2s_caller_details_required
Finding fires on the invoke_agent span
Finding's severity is 'error'
Finding's fixHint references CallerDetails on InvokeAgentScope.Start() and the MAC portal visibility issue

evals.description: Inference span starting before its parent invoke_agent surfaces rule-scope_ordering.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the time-ordering violation and emits rule-scope_ordering with severity warning.
expectations: common-mistakes.js validateTrace emits rule-scope_ordering
Finding fires on the inference span
Finding's severity is 'warning'
Finding's fixHint mentions clock skew or scope-outside-using-block

evals.description: JSON and protobuf wire formats produce identical findings on the same logical trace.
evals.expected_output: Running the skill twice — once with a JSONL produced from a protobuf POST, once from an equivalent JSON POST — produces identical sets of rule findings (same ruleIds, same severities, same metadata fields). The wire format is invisible to the validator pipeline.
expectations: decoder.decode() handles both content-types and yields the same uniform shape
schema-driven.js validateSpan emits the same findings (same count, same ruleIds) for both wire formats
common-mistakes.js validateTrace emits the same findings for both wire formats
report.js format produces identical markdown for both runs
